reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Camellia Deep Collagen Firming Ampoule 30ml
reviews.text: This has been a great product from first use. Absorbs quickly and well into the skin and though the formula feels thick it’s not sticky or hard to manage. Near the end you have to fight with the dropper a bit but over all this is a really great product and could be a staple in your routine. I liked that I was able to immediately see results. My skin is very acne prone sensitive and I’m working on repairing my skin barrier
reviews.zh: 由第一次用開始，呢件產品已經好正。佢吸收得好快又好，雖然質感感覺厚，但唔會黐笠或者難用。去到接近用完嘅時候，個滴管會有少少難撈，但整體嚟講呢件真係好正，可以成為你日常routine嘅必備品。我鍾意佢可以即刻見到效果。我皮膚極易生暗瘡又敏感，而家努力修護緊個皮膚屏障。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Camellia Deep Collagen Firming Ampoule 30ml
reviews.text:
I loved this serum. I use it for winter and I could see results within a week. My skin felt firmer, calmer and hydrated. I have rosacea and very sensitive skin so I’m glad it suited me
10/10 will buy again
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢支精華。冬天用，一個星期內已經見到效果。皮膚感覺更緊緻、穩定同保濕。我有玫瑰痤瘡而且皮膚好敏感，好慶幸佢啱我用。10/10會再買。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Camellia Deep Collagen Firming Ampoule 30ml
reviews.text: the second time I bought this for my husband. he really likes this product and many more from round lab :) he finally started doing skin care rutine thanks for their products!!!
reviews.zh: 第二次幫老公買呢件。佢真係好鍾意呢件產品，仲有round lab其他好多嘢 :) 多謝佢哋嘅產品，佢終於開始做護膚routine!!!

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Camellia Deep Collagen Firming Ampoule 30ml
reviews.text:
I’m 53 years old, and I can honestly say this product works beautifully. My skin is dry and slightly sagging with fine lines, but once I started using the serum, my skin quickly absorbed it — and soon after, it began to smooth out. Even the deepest wrinkle on my face, the one between my eyebrows, has softened and no longer bothers me!
I definitely want to buy more — it’s an excellent product!
reviews.zh: 我53歲，可以講真呢件產品效果好好。我皮膚乾、輕微鬆弛兼有細紋，但自從開始用呢支精華之後，皮膚好快吸收晒，唔耐之後就開始變得平滑。就連我塊面最深嗰條紋——即係兩眉中間嗰條——都軟化咗，再都唔困擾我！真係好想再買多啲——正嘢！

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Camellia Deep Collagen Firming Ampoule 30ml
reviews.text: Product hood but the worst pipette I’ve ever had on a product, so bad in fact that it may be faulty, can not get hardly any product into it so for that I can only give 3 stars
reviews.zh: 產品本身唔錯，但係我用過嘅產品入面最差嘅滴管，差到可能係有問題，幾乎吸唔到任何產品入去，所以呢樣嘢我只能夠俾3星。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Camellia Deep Collagen Firming Ampoule 30ml
reviews.text:
The product comes in a well-designed package that’s convenient for daily use.
Its texture is light and mineral-rich, providing a refreshing feel and leaving the skin smooth.
The ingredients are high-quality, delivering a gentle and nourishing treatment for the face.
The size allows for long-term use, making it especially cost-effective.
Perfect for anyone who appreciates high-quality Korean skincare.
reviews.zh: 產品包裝設計精良，方便日常使用。質地輕盈兼富礦物成分，感覺清爽，搽完皮膚滑溜。成份高質，溫和又滋養塊面。容量足以長期使用，特別抵食。適合所有鍾意高質韓國護膚品嘅人。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Camellia Deep Collagen Firming Ampoule 30ml
reviews.text: I'm not sure if it truly makes my skin firm, but it gives the feeling like my skin is tighter. It's hydrating and leaves a nice glow. Reason for taking off a star is because of the dropper as it is weak and does not pick up the serum very well, which can get pretty frustrating. Maybe I got a defective bottle, but the dropper makes me not want to repurchase even though I like the serum itself.
reviews.zh: 我唔肯定佢係咪真係令到我皮膚緊緻，但用完感覺皮膚好似實咗。佢保濕，仲有淡淡光澤。扣一粒星係因為支滴管太弱，吸精華吸得唔好，會好煩。可能我攞到支壞嘅，但即使我鍾意呢支精華本身，支滴管都令我唔想再買。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Camellia Deep Collagen Firming Ampoule 30ml
reviews.text: I was disappointed with the texture; it was super sticky and didn't give the mature skin the fresh look that I was expecting. I am not going to buy it again. However, this formula will work for younger girls with dry skin; I will update my review once I finish it.
reviews.zh: 我對質地好失望，超級黐笠，俾唔到成熟肌我期待嗰種清新感覺。我唔會再買。不過呢個配方可能啱後生啲、乾性皮膚嘅女仔用；等我用完再更新評價。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
